tei:bibl.tei:title: Blessing for Rosh Ḥodesh Kislev, by Kohenet Ilana Joy Streit
tei:bibl.tei:author: Kohenet Ilana Joy Streit
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: A poem-blessing for the Hebrew month of Kislev, suitable for Birkat HaḤodesh, Rosh Ḥodesh Kislev, and the whole month.
Please note that this was written in the Northern Hemisphere and conveys the experience of Ḥeshvan as a winter month.

The references to Hershel and hard-boiled eggs are from the popular picture book, Hershel and the Ḥanukkah Goblins, by Eric A. Kimmel, which is highly recommended both in general and in further understanding this poem.
